42218.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `RUN --mount=type=secret` — secret'ni faqat shu `RUN` davomida fayl sifatida beradi, hech qaysi layer'ga, history'ga yozilmaydi. `RUN --mount=type=cache` — paket menejer/kompilyator keshini build'lar orasida saqlaydi, lekin image'ga kiritmaydi. Natija: xavfsizroq va tezroq build.

**Muammo:** Private Go modul uchun token kerak — `ARG TOKEN` bilan bersangiz `docker history` da ko'rinadi. Har build'da `go mod download` 2 daqiqa — chunki kesh layer bilan birga yo'qoladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
RUN --mount=type=secret,id=netrc ...   /root/.netrc faqat RUN vaqtida, keyin yo'q
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/go/pkg/mod ...
       ^ builder'dagi doimiy kesh papkasi, image layer'ida emas
```

**Amalda:**
```dockerfile
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
FROM golang:1.25 AS build
WORKDIR /src
COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/go/pkg/mod \
    --mount=type=secret,id=netrc,target=/root/.netrc \
    go mod download
COPY . .
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/go/pkg/mod \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/go-build \
    CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o /app ./cmd/api
```
```bash
docker buildx build --secret id=netrc,src=$HOME/.netrc -t api:1.5.0 .
# env'dan: --secret id=token,env=GH_TOKEN
docker history --no-trunc api:1.5.0 | grep -i netrc   # hech narsa
```
SSH (private git): `RUN --mount=type=ssh git clone ...` + `docker build --ssh default .`

| Mount | Nima uchun |
|---|---|
| `type=secret` | token, `.npmrc`, `.netrc` |
| `type=ssh` | SSH agent forwarding |
| `type=cache` | `/root/.npm`, `/go/pkg/mod`, `/var/cache/apt` |
| `type=bind` | context'dan COPY'siz o'qish |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1` va BuildKit kerak (zamonaviy Docker'da default).
- Cache mount CI'da ephemeral runner'da saqlanmaydi.
- Secret'ni `RUN cat /run/secrets/x > /app/config` qilib layer'ga yozib qo'yish.

**Senior nuqta:** Cache mount'lar `--cache-to` bilan eksport qilinmaydi — CI'da persistent builder yoki `buildkit-cache-dance` kabi yechim kerak. Secret uchun qoida: build vaqtida mount, runtime'da orchestrator secret.

42219.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `docker history` — har layer qaysi instruksiya bilan va qancha hajmda yaratilganini ko'rsatadi. `docker inspect` — metadata: User, Env, Cmd, Entrypoint, Labels, digest. `dive` — layer'lar bo'yicha fayl tizimini interaktiv ko'rish va "wasted space" topish. Registry'dagi image'ni yuklamasdan — `crane`/`skopeo`.

**Nega kerak:** Begona image ishlatishdan oldin (root bilan ishlaydimi? secret bormi?), image nega 1 GB ekanini topish, yoki incident'da nima deploy qilinganini aniqlash.

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker history --no-trunc api:1.5.0
# CREATED BY                                  SIZE
# RUN /bin/sh -c apt-get install ...          312MB   <- shu layer katta
docker image inspect api:1.5.0 --format '{{json .Config}}' \
  | jq '{User, Env, Cmd, Entrypoint, ExposedPorts, Labels}'
docker image inspect api:1.5.0 --format '{{.RepoDigests}}'
dive api:1.5.0                     # Tab: layer'lar, fayl daraxti, efficiency %
CI=true dive api:1.5.0 --lowestEfficiency=0.95   # CI'da gate
crane config ghcr.io/acme/api:1.5.0 | jq .config   # pull'siz
skopeo inspect docker://ghcr.io/acme/api:1.5.0
docker run --rm --entrypoint sh api:1.5.0 -c 'ls -la /app'   # shell bo'lsa
```
`User` bo'sh chiqsa — container root bilan ishlaydi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Keyingi layer'da `rm secret.txt` — fayl oldingi layer'da bor, `docker save` bilan chiqariladi.
- `docker history` multi-stage builder bosqichlarini ko'rsatmaydi — faqat final.
- `Env` da parol — image'ga kirgan secret, rotatsiya kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Image metadata'ga OCI label'lar qo'ying (`org.opencontainers.image.source`, `revision`) — incident'da image'dan commit'gacha bir buyruqda borasiz. SBOM (`docker buildx build --sbom=true`) image ichidagi paketlarni rasmiy ro'yxatlaydi.

42220.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **scratch** — butunlay bo'sh image, faqat siz qo'ygan fayllar. **distroless** — scratch'ga yaqin, lekin CA sertifikatlar, tzdata, `/etc/passwd` (nonroot user) va ba'zi variantlarda glibc bor; shell va paket menejer yo'q. Afzallik: kichik hajm, deyarli CVE yo'q, hujumchi uchun asbob yo'q. Kamchilik: ichiga kirib debug qilib bo'lmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
| | scratch | distroless/static | distroless/base | alpine/slim |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Hajm | 0 | ~2 MB | ~20 MB | 5-80 MB |
| CA, tzdata | yo'q | bor | bor | bor |
| libc | yo'q | yo'q | glibc | musl/glibc |
| Shell | yo'q | yo'q | yo'q | bor |

**Amalda:**
```dockerfile
FROM golang:1.25 AS build
WORKDIR /src
COPY . .
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o /app ./cmd/api

FROM gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12:nonroot
COPY --from=build /app /app
USER nonroot:nonroot
ENTRYPOINT ["/app"]
```
scratch'da o'zingiz qo'shasiz:
```dockerfile
FROM scratch
COPY --from=build /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt /etc/ssl/certs/
COPY --from=build /etc/passwd /etc/passwd
COPY --from=build /app /app
USER 10001
ENTRYPOINT ["/app"]
```

**Debug qilish:**
```bash
docker run -it --rm --pid=container:api --network=container:api nicolaka/netshoot
docker debug api                                # Docker Desktop/Pro
kubectl debug -it pod/api --image=busybox --target=api   # K8s ephemeral container
```
Yoki `gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12:debug` (busybox shell bilan) faqat vaqtincha.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- CGO binary scratch'da: "no such file or directory" — dinamik linker yo'q.
- Shell form `CMD /app` — `/bin/sh` yo'q, ishlamaydi; exec form majburiy.
- HEALTHCHECK `curl` bilan — curl yo'q.

**Senior nuqta:** Distroless'ga o'tish debug madaniyatini o'zgartiradi: ichiga kirish o'rniga log, metrics, ephemeral debug container. Chainguard/Wolfi image'lari — kunlik yangilanadigan muqobil.

42221.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `docker save`/`load` — **image**'ni barcha layer'lari, tag'lari va metadata'si (CMD, ENV) bilan tar'ga saqlaydi va tiklaydi. `docker export`/`import` — **container**'ning joriy fayl tizimini bitta tekis tar sifatida oladi; layer tarixi va metadata yo'qoladi.

**Nega kerak:** Internet'siz (air-gapped) serverga image yetkazish — `save`/`load`. Container'dagi fayllar snapshot'ini olish yoki tekis rootfs kerak bo'lsa — `export`.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
save:   image -> tar (manifest + layer'lar + config) -> load -> xuddi o'sha image
export: container FS (merged) -> tar -> import -> 1 layer, CMD/ENV yo'q
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker save api:1.5.0 | gzip > api-1.5.0.tar.gz
scp api-1.5.0.tar.gz server:
ssh server 'gunzip -c api-1.5.0.tar.gz | docker load'
# Loaded image: api:1.5.0

docker export mycontainer > fs.tar
docker import --change 'CMD ["/app"]' fs.tar myimage:flat
docker history myimage:flat      # bitta layer
```
Kubernetes node'ga: `ctr -n k8s.io images import api.tar`; kind'da `kind load docker-image api:1.5.0`.

| | save / load | export / import |
|---|---|---|
| Obyekt | image | container |
| Layer'lar | saqlanadi | bitta layer |
| CMD/ENV/USER | saqlanadi | yo'qoladi (`--change` bilan qayta beriladi) |
| Volume ma'lumoti | yo'q | yo'q |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `export` volume ichidagi ma'lumotni olmaydi — faqat container FS.
- `save` tar'ida secret bo'lsa — hammasi ochiq (layer'lar shunchaki tar).
- `import` qilingan image'da ENTRYPOINT yo'q — "no command specified".

**Senior nuqta:** Air-gapped muhitda bir martalik `save` o'rniga ichki registry (Harbor) + `skopeo copy` yoki `crane` bilan replikatsiya — versiya va audit saqlanadi.

42222.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `docker inspect` — container'ning to'liq holati: status, exit code, OOMKilled, restart soni, IP, mount'lar, health, limitlar. `docker stats` — real vaqtda CPU, RAM, tarmoq va disk I/O. `docker events` — hodisalar oqimi: start, die, oom, health_status, restart.

**Nega kerak:** "Container o'zi qayta ishga tushib turibdi" — `ps` faqat hozirgi holatni ko'rsatadi. Nima bo'lganini `events` va `inspect` aytadi.

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker inspect api --format \
  '{{.State.Status}} exit={{.State.ExitCode}} oom={{.State.OOMKilled}} restarts={{.RestartCount}} started={{.State.StartedAt}}'
# running exit=0 oom=false restarts=14 started=2026-10-03T09:12:01Z
docker inspect api --format '{{range .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}} {{end}}'
docker inspect api --format '{{json .Mounts}}' | jq
docker inspect api --format '{{json .State.Health}}' | jq '.Status, .Log[-1].Output'
docker inspect api --format 'mem={{.HostConfig.Memory}} cpus={{.HostConfig.NanoCpus}}'

docker stats --no-stream --format 'table {{.Name}}\t{{.CPUPerc}}\t{{.MemUsage}}\t{{.PIDs}}'
docker events --since 1h --filter event=die --filter event=oom
# 2026-10-03T09:11:58 container die ... (exitCode=137, name=api)
```
`restarts=14` + `events` dagi `die exitCode=137` + `oom` — tashxis tayyor: xotira limiti.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `docker stats` bir lahzalik ko'rinish — trend uchun cAdvisor/Prometheus kerak.
- `inspect` env'ni ham ko'rsatadi — secret ko'rinadi, chiqishni log'ga tashlamang.
- `events` faqat daemon xotirasidagi yaqin tarixni beradi.

**Senior nuqta:** Bu buyruqlar — qo'lda tashxis. Production'da shu ma'lumotlar metrikaga aylanishi kerak (cAdvisor -> Prometheus: restart, OOM, throttling) va alert bilan qoplanishi kerak.

42223.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `/etc/docker/daemon.json` da `"live-restore": true` yoqiladi. Shunda dockerd to'xtasa yoki yangilansa ham container'lar `containerd-shim` ostida ishlayveradi, daemon qaytgach ularga qayta ulanadi. Sozlama `systemctl reload docker` bilan, restart'siz qo'llanadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
dockerd (restart) x
containerd -> shim -> app   <- ishlayapti, trafik xizmat qilinadi
dockerd (qaytdi) -> containerd'dan holatni oladi -> boshqaruv tiklandi
```

**Amalda:**
```json
{
  "live-restore": true,
  "log-driver": "local",
  "log-opts": { "max-size": "50m", "max-file": "3" },
  "default-ulimits": { "nofile": { "Name": "nofile", "Soft": 65536, "Hard": 65536 } }
}
```
```bash
sudo dockerd --validate --config-file /etc/docker/daemon.json   # sintaksis tekshiruvi
sudo systemctl reload docker
docker info | grep -i "live restore"      # Live Restore Enabled: true
sudo systemctl restart docker && docker ps   # container uptime o'zgarmagan
```

**Cheklovlar:**
- Major versiya upgrade'da kafolat yo'q.
- Swarm mode bilan ishlamaydi.
- Daemon uzoq vaqt yo'q bo'lsa — log FIFO buferi to'ladi va ilova stdout'ga yozishda bloklanadi.
- Daemon o'chiq paytida yangi container, `docker exec`, port proxy ishlamaydi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- JSON xatosi bilan `daemon.json` — dockerd umuman ko'tarilmaydi; avval `--validate`.
- Paket menejer docker'ni avtomatik yangilaydi — versiyani pin qiling.
- live-restore'ni yuqori mavjudlik deb hisoblash.

**Senior nuqta:** Bu bitta host ichidagi yumshatish. Haqiqiy mavjudlik — bir nechta host va orchestrator (K8s/Swarm/Nomad), host'larni rolling tartibda yangilash.

42224.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Avval zararni cheklang: rollout'ni to'xtating (`rollout pause`) yoki darhol `rollout undo` — eski pod'lar trafik olayapti, demak foydalanuvchi hali ta'sirlanmagan bo'lishi mumkin. Keyin sababni toping: yangi pod nega Ready emas — `describe` (probe xatosi, Pending, image), `logs`, readiness endpoint, bog'liqliklar (yangi config, secret, migratsiya).

**Vaziyat tahlili:** `maxUnavailable` tufayli rollout yangi pod Ready bo'lmaguncha eskilarini o'chirmaydi — bu himoya ishlayapti. Lekin `progressDeadlineSeconds` o'tsa Deployment faqat `ProgressDeadlineExceeded` deydi, avtomatik qaytarmaydi.

**Qadamlar:**
```
1. Ta'sir:  error rate/latency normalmi? eski pod'lar yetarlimi?
2. Barqarorlashtirish: undo (yoki pause)
3. Diagnostika: yangi RS pod'lari -> describe/logs/events
4. Tuzatish -> qayta deploy (canary bilan)
5. Postmortem: nega CI/stage ushlamadi?
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl rollout status deploy/api --timeout=10s
kubectl get rs -l app=api                      # yangi RS: DESIRED 1 READY 0
kubectl get pods -l app=api,pod-template-hash=<yangi>
kubectl describe pod <yangi-pod> | sed -n '/Conditions/,$p'
#   Readiness probe failed: HTTP probe failed with statuscode: 503
kubectl logs <yangi-pod> --tail=100
kubectl rollout undo deploy/api                # tez qaytarish
# GitOps bo'lsa: Argo CD auto-sync'ni vaqtincha o'chirib undo, keyin git revert
kubectl diff -f deploy.yaml                    # nima o'zgargan: image, env, probe, resurs
```
Tipik sabablar: readiness yo'li o'zgargan, yangi env/Secret yo'q, DB migratsiyasi qilinmagan, yangi versiya ko'proq memory so'raydi va Pending, image arxitekturasi noto'g'ri.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- "Biroz kutaylik" — eski pod'lar ham restart bo'lsa (masalan node drain) sig'im kamayadi.
- GitOps'da faqat `kubectl rollout undo` — Argo CD qaytadan buzuq versiyani qo'yadi.
- Bir vaqtda ham debug, ham tuzatish deploy — vaziyat chalkashadi; avval barqarorlashtiring.

**Senior nuqta:** Bu scenario rollout himoyasi to'g'ri ishlaganini ko'rsatadi. Keyingi qadam — uni avtomatlashtirish: CI'da `rollout status` timeout + avtomatik undo yoki Argo Rollouts AnalysisTemplate bilan metrikaga asoslangan abort.

42225.a:
```sh kubectl get pods -A --field-selector=status.phase=Pending kubectl describe pod

| tail # 0/12 nodes: Insufficient memory; pod didn't trigger scale-up: ... kubectl -n kube-system logs deploy/cluster-autoscaler | grep -i -E "scale.up|max|failed" kubectl get nodes -L node.kubernetes.io/instance-type,topology.kubernetes.io/zone aws ec2 describe-subnets --query 'Subnets[].[SubnetId,AvailableIpAddressCount]' ``` Tipik sabablar: - "pod didn't trigger scale-up: max node group size reached". - requests node allocatable'dan katta — hech qanday node mos emas. - AWS VPC CNI: subnet'da IP tugadi (har pod VPC IP oladi) — prefix delegation yoki katta subnet. - Spot sig'imi yo'q — instance turlarini diversifikatsiya.

42226.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Node NotReady bo'lganda: node controller ~40s ichida `NotReady` va `node.kubernetes.io/unreachable:NoExecute` taint qo'yadi; pod'lar default `tolerationSeconds: 300` dan keyin evict qilinib, controller'lar ularni boshqa node'larda qayta yaratadi. StatefulSet pod'lari esa avtomatik ko'chirilmaydi (ikki nusxa xavfi). Siz: ta'sirni baholaysiz, node'ni tekshirasiz (kubelet, containerd, disk, memory, tarmoq), tiklaysiz yoki almashtirasiz.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
kubelet heartbeat (Lease) to'xtadi
  -> 40s: node NotReady, taint unreachable:NoExecute
  -> 300s: pod'lar evict (Deployment pod'lari boshqa node'da qayta yaratiladi)
  -> StatefulSet pod: "Terminating/Unknown" da qoladi (node tasdiqlamaguncha)
  -> PV (RWO) eski node'ga bog'liq: Multi-Attach kutadi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl get nodes
kubectl describe node worker-4 | sed -n '/Conditions/,/Addresses/p'
kubectl get pods -A -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=worker-4
# Node'ga kirish (SSM/SSH/serial console):
systemctl status kubelet containerd
journalctl -u kubelet -n 200 --no-pager     # PLEG not healthy, certificate, disk
df -h; free -m; dmesg -T | tail -50          # disk to'la, OOM, kernel xato
# Tiklab bo'lmasa:
kubectl drain worker-4 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force
kubectl delete node worker-4                 # bulutda node group yangisini yaratadi
# StatefulSet uchun (node haqiqatan o'chganiga ishonch hosil qilib):
kubectl taint node worker-4 node.kubernetes.io/out-of-service=nodeshutdown:NoExecute
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Node "o'lik" emas, faqat tarmoqdan uzilgan bo'lishi mumkin — StatefulSet pod'ini force delete qilish ikki yozuvchi (split-brain) va ma'lumot buzilishi xavfi.
- Barcha replika shu node'da bo'lgan (spread yo'q) — 5 daqiqa outage.
- Node qayta tirilgach eski pod'lar bilan to'qnashuv — kubelet ularni tozalaydi, lekin kuzating.

**Senior nuqta:** Node yo'qolishi — normal hodisa sifatida loyihalansin: kamida 2 replika, topology spread, PDB, tez reschedule kerak bo'lsa `tolerationSeconds` ni kamaytirish. Bulutda "tuzatish" o'rniga "almashtirish" (cattle) — odatda tezroq va xavfsizroq.

42227.a:
```sh
kubectl -n kube-system top pods -l k8s-app=kube-dns
kubectl -n kube-system logs -l k8s-app=kube-dns | grep -i -E "timeout|SERVFAIL"
# pod ichidan
for i in $(seq 50); do dig +short +time=1 api.payments.svc.cluster.local > /dev/null || echo fail; done
conntrack -S | grep insert_failed        # node'da
```
```promql
sum(rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{rcode="SERVFAIL"}[5m]))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le)(rate(coredns_dns_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])))
```
Yechimlar: NodeLocal DNSCache (har node'da cache, TCP upstream), CoreDNS HPA/proportional autoscaler, `dnsConfig.options: ndots: 2`, `single-request-reopen` (glibc), ilovada DNS cache va qayta ulanishni kamaytirish (connection pool).

42228.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Darhol tiklash: GitOps bo'lsa — Argo CD/Flux Deployment'ni Git'dan avtomatik qayta yaratadi (self-heal yoki qo'lda sync). GitOps bo'lmasa — Git/CI'dagi manifestdan qayta `apply` yoki Velero backup'idan tiklash. Keyin: audit log bilan kim, qachon, qanday huquq bilan qilganini aniqlang va qaytmasligi uchun huquq va jarayonni o'zgartiring (blameless).

**Vaziyat:** Deployment o'chirildi -> ReplicaSet va pod'lar ham o'chdi (cascade) -> servis to'liq to'xtadi. Service, ConfigMap, Secret, PVC odatda qoladi (alohida obyekt).

**Qadamlar:**
```
1. Tiklash (daqiqalar):  Argo sync / kubectl apply / velero restore
2. Tekshirish:           pod'lar Ready, endpoint'lar, SLO tiklandi
3. Tergov:               audit log -> user, source IP, vaqt
4. Oldini olish:         RBAC, GitOps-only, admission/deletion protection
5. Postmortem:           odamni emas, tizimni tuzatish
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
argocd app sync api-prod                       # yoki selfHeal o'zi qiladi
kubectl apply -f k8s/prod/api/                 # GitOps yo'q bo'lsa
velero restore create --from-backup daily-20261003 --include-resources deployments \
  --include-namespaces prod --selector app=api
# Kim qildi? (EKS: CloudWatch audit log; self-managed: apiserver audit)
# filter: verb=delete, objectRef.resource=deployments, objectRef.namespace=prod
kubectl auth can-i delete deployments -n prod --list --as=alice
```
Oldini olish: odamlarga prod'da faqat read-only rol, yozish faqat GitOps controller orqali; break-glass rol vaqtinchalik va audit bilan; muhim resurslar uchun ValidatingAdmissionPolicy bilan DELETE'ni cheklash; Argo CD'da `prune` ehtiyotkorligi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Git'da manifest eskirgan (kimdir qo'lda o'zgartirgan) — tiklangan versiya prod'dagidan farq qiladi.
- Audit logging o'chiq — kim qilganini bilib bo'lmaydi; avvaldan yoqing.
- Aybdorni jazolash — keyingi safar odamlar xatolarni yashiradi.

**Senior nuqta:** Bu incident'ning ildiz sababi — "odam prod'da delete qila oladi" degan tizim dizayni. GitOps + read-only prod kirish + audit — bunday xatoni 10 daqiqalik avtomatik tiklanishga, keyin esa umuman imkonsiz narsaga aylantiradi.

42229.a:
```sh
kubectl get pod api-x -o jsonpath='{.status.containerStatuses[0].lastState.terminated}'
# {"exitCode":137,"reason":"OOMKilled",...}  yoki reason: "Error"
kubectl get events --field-selector involvedObject.name=api-x
# Liveness probe failed ... Container api failed liveness probe, will be restarted
dmesg -T | grep -i -E "killed process|oom"        # node'da
```
| Reason | Sabab |
|---|---|
| OOMKilled | cgroup memory limit — qisqa pik (katta so'rov, JSON yuklash) |
| Error + liveness event | probe timeout (GC pauza, CPU throttling, sekin dependency) |
| Evicted | node pressure |
Yechim: memory'ni yuqori rezolyutsiyada kuzatish (`container_memory_working_set_bytes` max_over_time), liveness timeout/threshold'ni yumshatish, limit va GOMEMLIMIT.

42230.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Pod'ga to'g'ridan ishlasa, muammo oradagi qatlamda: ingress controller yoki tashqi LB'ning **cheklov va timeout**'lari. **413** — request body limiti (ingress-nginx default `proxy-body-size: 1m`). **504** — upstream javobi ingress timeout'idan (default 60s) uzun. **499** — klient (yoki undan oldingi LB) javobni kutmay ulanishni yopdi — odatda LB/klient timeout'i ingress timeout'idan qisqa.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
client (timeout 30s) -> Cloud LB (idle timeout 60s) -> ingress-nginx (proxy-read-timeout 60s) -> pod
  body 5MB > 1m limit         -> 413 (ingress qaytaradi, pod'ga yetmaydi)
  pod 90s ishlaydi            -> 504 (ingress timeout)
  client 30s'da voz kechdi    -> 499 (nginx log'ida)
Timeout'lar zanjiri: tashqidan ichkariga qarab kamayishi kerak.
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl logs -n ingress-nginx deploy/ingress-nginx-controller | grep -E '" (413|499|504) '
#  ... "POST /upload" 413 ... request_length ...
#  ... upstream_response_time 60.001 ... 504
curl -sv -X POST --data-binary @5mb.bin https://shop.example.com/upload -o /dev/null
kubectl get ingress shop -o yaml | grep -A10 annotations
```
```yaml
metadata:
  annotations:
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-body-size: "20m"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-read-timeout: "120"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-send-timeout: "120"
```
Cloud LB: AWS ALB `idle_timeout.timeout_seconds`, NLB/GCLB backend timeout'ini ham moslang.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Faqat ingress timeout'ini oshirish — LB timeout'i qisqa bo'lsa endi 504 o'rniga 502/499 olasiz.
- Uzun so'rovlarni timeout'ni oshirib "hal qilish" — ulanishlar band bo'ladi; uzoq ish uchun asinxron pattern (202 + status endpoint, navbat).
- Katta fayllar ingress orqali — xotira/disk buffer; to'g'ridan S3 presigned URL'ga yuklash yaxshiroq.
- Body limitni hamma joyda katta qilish — DoS yuzasi; faqat kerakli path/host uchun.

**Senior nuqta:** Timeout byudjetini butun zanjir uchun hujjatlang (klient > LB > ingress > ilova > DB) va ilovada ham deadline/context'ni qo'llang: so'rov kerakli vaqtdan oshsa, hamma qatlam bir xil qarorga kelsin.

42231.a:
Tarkibiy qismlar:
- **Developer portal** (Backstage): servis katalogi, ownership, "yangi servis" shabloni.
- **Paved road**: 1 buyruq/klik bilan repo + pipeline + deploy + monitoring.
- **Abstraksiya**: jamoa `app.yaml` (image, port, resurs, env) yozadi; platforma Deployment, HPA, PDB, NetworkPolicy, ServiceMonitor'ni generatsiya qiladi.
- **Guardrail'lar**: Kyverno (limitlar, nonroot, ruxsat etilgan registry), quota, xarajat ko'rinishi.
- **Escape hatch**: murakkab holatda xom manifest — lekin policy'lar baribir amal qiladi.

O'lchov: yangi servis prod'gacha vaqt, DORA metrikalari, platform NPS, platformadan tashqarida qolgan servislar soni.
Anti-pattern: platformani majburlash va jamoalar ehtiyojini so'ramaslik; "hamma narsani abstraksiya qilish" — debug'ni imkonsiz qiladi.

42232.a:
Tartib:
1. **Contain:** `aws iam update-access-key --status Inactive`; o'sha user'ga `Deny *`; role sessiyalari uchun "Revoke active sessions".
2. **Scope (CloudTrail):** shu `accessKeyId` bilan qilingan barcha API chaqiruvlar, barcha region'larda (hujumchilar boshqa region'larda instance ochadi).
3. **Persistence:** yangi IAM user/access key/role, trust policy o'zgarishi, Lambda, EC2 user data — hammasi o'chiriladi.
4. **Eradicate:** begona EC2/GPU instance'lar — forensika uchun EBS snapshot, keyin terminate.
5. **Recover:** secret'larni rotatsiya, AWS Support'ga xarajat bo'yicha murojaat.
6. **Prevent:** static key yo'q (SSO, OIDC), GitHub push protection/gitleaks, SCP bilan foydalanilmaydigan region'larni bloklash, GuardDuty + budget alert.

42233.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Avval **qon to'xtatish**: qaysi so'rovlar CPU'ni yeyotganini (`pg_stat_activity`, `pg_stat_statements`, Performance Insights) topib, kerak bo'lsa og'ir so'rovni bekor qilish yoki yangi deploy'ni rollback qilish. Keyin **ildiz sabab**: indeks yo'qligi, N+1, cache yiqilishi, autovacuum, ulanishlar bo'roni. Vertikal scale — vaqtinchalik yordam, yechim emas.

**Qanday yondashiladi:**
```
1. Observe:   Performance Insights -> top SQL va wait event'lar; deploy vaqti bilan solishtirish
2. Contain:   og'ir so'rovni cancel, deploy rollback, feature flag o'chirish, rate limit
3. Diagnose:  EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) -> seq scan? noto'g'ri plan? lock?
4. Fix:       indeks (CONCURRENTLY), so'rovni qayta yozish, cache, pool
5. Prevent:   slow query alert, CI'da EXPLAIN tekshiruvi, yuk testi
```

**Amalda:**
```sql
-- hozir nima ishlayapti
SELECT pid, now()-query_start AS dur, state, wait_event_type, wait_event, left(query,80)
FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state <> 'idle' ORDER BY dur DESC LIMIT 20;

-- umumiy vaqt bo'yicha eng qimmat so'rovlar
SELECT calls, round(total_exec_time) AS total_ms, round(mean_exec_time,1) AS mean_ms,
       rows, left(query,80)
FROM pg_stat_statements ORDER BY total_exec_time DESC LIMIT 10;

-- plan
EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 42;
-- Seq Scan on orders (rows=12000000) -> indeks yo'q

CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_orders_customer ON orders(customer_id);
SELECT pg_cancel_backend(12345);      -- so'rovni bekor qilish (terminate emas)
```
```bash
aws pi get-resource-metrics --service-type RDS --identifier db-ABC123 \
  --metric-queries '[{"Metric":"db.load.avg","GroupBy":{"Group":"db.sql_tokenized"}}]' \
  --start-time 2026-10-02T09:00:00Z --end-time 2026-10-02T10:00:00Z
```

**Tez-tez sabablar:**
| Sabab | Belgisi |
|---|---|
| Yangi deploy'dagi indekssiz so'rov | CPU deploy vaqtida sakragan, seq scan |
| N+1 | `calls` juda katta, `mean` kichik |
| Cache yiqildi | Redis hit rate tushgan, DB QPS keskin oshgan |
| Autovacuum orqada | dead tuple'lar, bloat, plan yomonlashgan |
| Ulanishlar bo'roni | connections limitga yaqin, ko'p qisqa sessiya |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Darrov instance'ni kattalashtirish — Multi-AZ'da bu failover (qisqa uzilish) va sabab saqlanib qoladi.
- Prod'da oddiy `CREATE INDEX` — jadval yozishga bloklanadi; `CONCURRENTLY` ishlating.
- `pg_terminate_backend` ni ommaviy ishlatish — tranzaksiyalar rollback, ilova xatolari.

**Senior nuqta:** Incident'dan keyin himoya qatlamlari: statement_timeout, connection pool limiti (RDS Proxy/PgBouncer), slow query va DB load alert'lari, va migratsiya/yangi so'rovlar uchun CI'da EXPLAIN review. Postmortem'da "nega buni deploy'dan oldin ushlamadik?" savoli asosiy.

42234.a:
**Qisqa javob:** AZ yiqilishi — kutilishi kerak bo'lgan oddiy hodisa. Omon qolish uchun oldindan: compute bir nechta AZ'da va qolgan AZ'larda yukni ko'tarishga **yetarli zaxira**; har AZ'da o'z NAT GW'si; DB va cache avtomatik failover bilan; stateful komponentlar AZ'ga bog'lanmagan; va eng muhimi — bularning hammasi **sinovdan** o'tgan (FIS, zonal shift).

**Qanday ko'rinadi:**
```
oldin:  AZ a [3 pod]  AZ b [3 pod]  AZ c [3 pod]   -> 9 pod, 66% yuk
AZ a o'ldi:           AZ b [3]      AZ c [3]       -> 6 pod, 100% yuk!  (zaxira kerak)
static stability: oldindan 4+4+4 = 12 pod -> AZ yo'qolsa 8 pod, ~75% yuk
```

**Tekshiruv ro'yxati:**
| Qatlam | Nima bo'lishi kerak |
|---|---|
| Compute | ASG/Karpenter 3 AZ subnet'ida, topology spread, N+1 zaxira sig'im |
| LB | ALB barcha AZ'larda, cross-zone, health check |
| NAT | har AZ'da o'z NAT GW va route table |
| DB | RDS Multi-AZ (avtomatik failover ~1-2 daq) |
| Cache | ElastiCache replica + automatic failover, multi-AZ |
| Stateful pod | EBS AZ'ga bog'liq -> replikatsiya ilova darajasida yoki EFS/S3 |
| Bog'liqliklar | ilova DNS keshi, retry/timeout, failover'ga chidamli klient |

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# K8s: pod'larni AZ'lar bo'yicha teng tarqatish
topologySpreadConstraints:
  - maxSkew: 1
    topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
    whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
    labelSelector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }
```
```bash
# AZ'ni sun'iy "o'chirish": ARC zonal shift (ALB/NLB trafigini AZ'dan olib ketadi)
aws arc-zonal-shift start-zonal-shift --resource-identifier $ALB_ARN \
  --away-from euc1-az1 --expires-in 1h --comment "game day"
# AWS FIS: AZ power interruption senariysi (EC2, EBS, RDS failover)
aws fis start-experiment --experiment-template-id EXT123
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Bitta NAT GW — bitta AZ yiqilishi boshqa AZ'larni ham internetsiz qoldiradi.
- Tiklanish uchun control plane'ga tayanish (AZ yiqilgach yangi instance ochish) — o'sha payt hamma ochadi, sig'im yetishmaydi.
- PDB va `maxSkew` siz pod'lar bitta AZ'ga to'planib qolgan — nazariy multi-AZ, amalda single-AZ.

**Senior nuqta:** "Static stability" tamoyili: tizim AZ yiqilganda hech narsa yaratmasdan, mavjud sig'im bilan ishlashda davom etishi kerak. Game day'larda sinamagan HA — faqat umid.

42235.a:
**Qisqa javob:** FinOps — xarajatni muhandislik ko'rsatkichiga aylantiruvchi uzluksiz jarayon: **Inform** (kim qancha sarflashini ko'rish — tag'lar, allocation, unit cost), **Optimize** (tez yutuqlar, rightsizing, narx modellari, arxitektura), **Operate** (budget, anomaly alert, PR'da xarajat bahosi, muntazam review). Maqsad — xarajatni kamaytirish emas, unit cost'ni (xarajat / so'rov, / mijoz) biznes o'sishidan sekin o'stirish.

**Qanday quriladi:**
```
Inform  -> majburiy tag'lar (SCP/Tag Policy), CUR + dashboard, OpenCost (K8s)
   |        "40% o'sish: 25% compute (jamoa X), 10% NAT/egress, 5% log'lar"
Optimize -> tez yutuqlar -> rightsizing/Graviton/Spot -> Savings Plans -> arxitektura
   |
Operate -> jamoa budget'lari, anomaly detection, Infracost PR'da, oylik review
   +----> qayta Inform (sikl)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# xarajat jamoa bo'yicha
aws ce get-cost-and-usage --time-period Start=2026-09-01,End=2026-10-01 \
  --granularity MONTHLY --metrics UnblendedCost --group-by Type=TAG,Key=team
# anomaly detection
aws ce create-anomaly-monitor --anomaly-monitor '{"MonitorName":"by-service","MonitorType":"DIMENSIONAL","MonitorDimension":"SERVICE"}'
# rightsizing tavsiyalari
aws compute-optimizer get-ec2-instance-recommendations --query 'instanceRecommendations[].[instanceArn,finding]'
# PR'da xarajat farqi
infracost diff --path . --compare-to infracost-base.json
```

**Optimallashtirish bosqichlari:**
| Bosqich | Harakatlar | Odatiy ta'sir |
|---|---|---|
| Tez | yetim resurslar, eski snapshot, gp2->gp3, log retention, dev'ni tunda o'chirish | 5-15% |
| O'rta | rightsizing, Graviton, Spot (stateless), Savings Plans (bazaviy yuk) | 15-40% |
| Arxitektura | NAT/cross-AZ trafik, VPC endpoint'lar, cache, S3 lifecycle/tiering | struktura o'zgaradi |

**Unit metrika:**
```
cost_per_1k_requests = oylik xarajat / (oylik so'rovlar / 1000)
xarajat +40%, so'rovlar +60% -> unit cost tushgan (yaxshi)
xarajat +40%, so'rovlar +10% -> samaradorlik yomonlashgan (tekshirish kerak)
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Savings Plans'ni rightsizing'dan **oldin** sotib olish — ortiqcha sig'imga 1-3 yilga bog'lanish.
- Tag'siz boshlash — "kim sarflayapti?" ga javob yo'q, optimizatsiya ham ko'r.
- Markaziy jamoa hammasini o'zi optimallashtiradi — ownership jamoalarda bo'lmasa o'sish qaytadi.
- Faqat umumiy summaga qarash — o'sish biznes o'sishiga mos bo'lishi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** Xarajat — arxitektura xususiyati va jamoa mas'uliyati: har jamoa o'z dashboard'i, budget'i va unit metrikasiga ega bo'lsin; yangi dizaynlarda xarajat bahosi xavfsizlik va ishonchlilik bilan bir qatorda review qilinsin.

42236.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Avval **o'lchash**: har job va step vaqti, eng sekin testlar, navbatda kutish vaqti. Keyin odatdagi yutuqlar: dependency va Docker **kesh**, job'larni **parallel** qilish (`needs` faqat haqiqiy bog'liqlik), testlarni **shard**'lash, monorepo'da **faqat o'zgargan** qismlar, uzun e2e — PR'da smoke, to'liq to'plam merge'dan keyin, tezroq yoki "issiq" runner'lar. Flaky testlar — karantin.

**Muammo:** 45 daqiqalik CI — jamoa o'zgarishlarni katta PR'larga yig'adi, review qiyinlashadi, xatolar ko'payadi, deploy chastotasi tushadi. Lead time asosan kutishdan iborat.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Oldin (ketma-ket):
 deps 6m -> lint 3m -> build 8m -> unit 10m -> docker 12m -> e2e 6m  = 45m
Keyin:
 deps (kesh) 30s
 +-- lint 3m
 +-- unit (4 shard) 3m
 +-- build + docker (BuildKit kesh) 3m
 +-- e2e smoke 3m (to'liq e2e - merge'dan keyin)
 = ~7-8m
```

| Muammo | Yechim |
|---|---|
| har safar dependency yuklash | kesh (go mod, npm), lockfile-hash kalit |
| Docker noldan | BuildKit cache (`type=registry`/`gha`), to'g'ri layer tartibi |
| ketma-ket job'lar | parallel, `needs` faqat kerakli joyda |
| monorepo'da hammasi | path filter, Nx/Bazel affected |
| uzun e2e | PR'da smoke, to'liq — merge/tunda |
| sekin runner | katta instance, warm self-hosted pool |

**Amalda:**
```bash
go test -json ./... | gotestsum --jsonfile t.json
gotestsum tool slowest --jsonfile t.json --threshold 1s    # eng sekin testlar
go test ./... -shuffle=on -count=1 -p 8
```
```dockerfile
# layer tartibi: kam o'zgaradigan yuqorida
COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/go/pkg/mod go mod download
COPY . .
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/go-build go build -o /app ./cmd/api
```
```yaml
on:
  pull_request:
    paths: ["services/billing/**", "libs/**"]
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- "Retry until green" — flaky testlar ishonchni yo'qotadi; karantin + egasi + ticket.
- Keshni noto'g'ri kalit bilan — eskirgan natija yoki hech qachon hit bo'lmaydi.
- Path filter bilan muhim bog'liqlikni o'tkazib yuborish (umumiy kutubxona o'zgarganda).

**Senior nuqta:** Maqsadni SLO kabi qo'y (PR CI p90 < 10 daq) va regressiyani kuzat — CI vaqti asta-sekin yana o'sadi. Eng ko'p yutuq ko'pincha bitta-ikkita juda sekin test yoki noto'g'ri Docker layer tartibidan keladi.

42237.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Avval **deploy bilan bog'liqligini** tasdiqlash (5xx vaqti deploy bilan mos, faqat yangi versiya label'ida). Bog'liq bo'lsa va **rollback xavfsiz** (migratsiya orqaga mos, oldingi artefakt bor) — **darhol rollback**, tergov keyin. Rollback xavfli bo'lsa — feature flag o'chirish yoki tez **roll-forward** hotfix. Qoida: avval foydalanuvchini tikla, keyin sababni qidir.

**Muammo:** Incident paytida "tez tuzatamiz" deb roll-forward qilish vasvasasi katta — lekin stress ostida yozilgan hotfix ko'pincha yangi xato keltiradi va uzilishni cho'zadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
5xx oshdi
  v
deploy bilan bog'liqmi?  (vaqt, version label bo'yicha 5xx, canary vs stable)
  |- yo'q -> boshqa sabab (dependency, trafik, infra) -> incident jarayoni
  v ha
flag bilan o'chirsa bo'ladimi? -> ha -> flag OFF (soniyalar)
  v yo'q
rollback xavfsizmi? (migratsiya backward-compatible? oldingi image bor?)
  |- ha  -> ROLLBACK -> tiklanishni tasdiqla -> RCA
  v yo'q
roll-forward: minimal hotfix, tezlashtirilgan, lekin testlangan pipeline
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# versiya bo'yicha xatolar (PromQL)
# sum by (version) (rate(http_requests_total{app="api",code=~"5.."}[5m]))
kubectl argo rollouts undo api               # yoki:
kubectl rollout undo deploy/api
helm rollback api 0                          # oldingi revision
git revert <sha> && git push                 # GitOps: config repo
kubectl rollout status deploy/api
```

**Rollback'ni mumkin qiluvchi amaliyotlar:**
- Expand/contract migratsiyalar (avval qo'shish, keyin ishlatish, oxirida o'chirish).
- Feature flag — kodni emas, funksiyani o'chirish.
- Immutable artefakt + GitOps — oldingi versiya bir buyruqda.
- Canary — muammo 5% trafikda ushlanadi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Sababni topmaguncha rollback qilmaslik — foydalanuvchilar kutib turadi.
- Destruktiv migratsiyadan keyin rollback — eski kod yangi sxemada sinadi.
- Rollback'dan keyin tiklanishni tekshirmaslik (balki sabab boshqa edi).

**Senior nuqta:** Qaror daraxtini incident'dan **oldin** runbook'ga yoz — stress paytida o'ylash qiyin. Rollback tez-tez qilinadigan, mashq qilingan oddiy amal bo'lsa, jamoa undan qo'rqmaydi.

42238.a:
```yaml
permissions: { id-token: write, contents: read }   # minimal GITHUB_TOKEN
jobs:
  deploy:
    environment: production          # approval + faqat shu job'ga prod secret'lar
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683   # SHA pin
    - uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
      with: { role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::123:role/deploy-prod, aws-region: eu-central-1 }
```
IAM trust policy'da `sub` cheklovi: `repo:acme/api:environment:production` — boshqa repo/branch role'ni ololmaydi.
Xavflar: `pull_request_target` + PR kodini checkout qilish (secret o'g'irlash), self-hosted runner'ni public repo'da ishlatish, `echo $SECRET` debug'da, kompromat bo'lgan action (tj-actions 2025 hodisasi).

42239.a:
**Qisqa javob:** DORA'ning to'rtta asosiy metrikasi: **Deployment frequency** (prod'ga qanchalik tez-tez), **Lead time for changes** (commit -> prod), **Change failure rate** (deploy'larning necha foizi incident/rollback beradi), **Time to restore** (incident -> tiklanish; 2023+ da "failed deployment recovery time" deb ham ataladi). Birinchi ikkitasi — tezlik, oxirgi ikkitasi — barqarorlik. Ular jamoa **o'z jarayonidagi to'siqlarni** topishi uchun, jamoalarni reyting qilish uchun emas.

**Muammo:** "Biz tezmizmi?" — hissiyot bilan javob beriladi. DORA tezlik va barqarorlikni o'lchanadigan qiladi va ular bir-biriga zid emasligini ko'rsatadi: kichik, tez-tez deploy'lar odatda failure rate'ni ham kamaytiradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Ma'lumot manbalari:
 Git (commit vaqti) + CI/CD (deploy vaqti) -> lead time, deploy frequency
 Incident tizimi (PagerDuty) + rollback'lar -> change failure rate, time to restore

Lead time tahlili (misol):
 commit -> PR ochildi  2s
 PR -> birinchi review 18s   <- to'siq (70%)
 review -> merge       3s
 merge -> prod         1s
```

| Metrika | Nima | Yuqori natija |
|---|---|---|
| Deployment frequency | prod'ga deploy chastotasi | kuniga bir necha |
| Lead time for changes | commit -> prod | < 1 kun |
| Change failure rate | incident beradigan deploy % | ~0-15% |
| Time to restore | incident -> tiklanish | < 1 soat |

**Amalda (o'lchash):**
```bash
# deploy chastotasi: GitHub deployments API
gh api repos/acme/api/deployments --paginate -q '.[] | select(.environment=="prod") | .created_at' | cut -c1-10 | sort | uniq -c
```
Vositalar: Four Keys (Google), Sleuth, LinearB, GitLab/GitHub o'rnatilgan DORA dashboard'lari.

**To'g'ri ishlatish:** trend kuzatish (o'z-o'zi bilan solishtirish), to'siqni topib eksperiment qilish (masalan, review SLA), retrospektivada muhokama.

**Noto'g'ri ishlatish:**
- "Deploy sonini oshiring" maqsadi — ma'nosiz mayda deploy'lar (Goodhart qonuni).
- Jamoalarni reyting qilish — ma'lumot manipulyatsiyasi, "incident" ta'rifini toraytirish.
- Individual performance o'lchovi sifatida.
- Kontekstni hisobga olmaslik (mobil ilova va backend servis turlicha).

**Senior nuqta:** Metrika — savol berish uchun, javob emas. DORA tadqiqotlari (2024-2025) qo'shimcha ravishda reliability va developer experience'ni ham o'lchashni tavsiya qiladi; faqat to'rt raqamga qarash noto'liq rasm beradi.

42240.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Birinchi 15 daqiqa: (1) alert'ni tasdiqlash va ta'sirni baholash (hamma endpoint'mi, bitta region'mi, foydalanuvchi sezyaptimi), (2) "nima o'zgardi" — deploy, config, feature flag, trafik, bog'liqlik, (3) qaysi qatlamda vaqt ketyapti — trace va dependency latency, saturation, (4) tez yumshatish (rollback, scale, flag o'chirish), (5) holatni e'lon qilish va kerak bo'lsa yordam chaqirish.

**Vaziyat tahlili:** error rate normal, p99 3x — xato emas, **navbat yoki sekin bog'liqlik**: GC pauzalar, DB lock/sekin query, connection pool to'lishi, CPU throttling, bitta yomon node/AZ, tashqi API sekinlashishi, cache miss to'lqini.

**Qadamlar:**
```
0-3 daq:  ack, dashboard: qaysi endpoint/region/pod? p50 ham oshdimi?
3-7 daq:  o'zgarishlar: deploy tarixi, argocd history, flag log, trafik grafigi
7-12 daq: trace: sekin span qaysi? DB/Redis/tashqi API latency, pool saturation,
          CPU throttling, bitta pod/node outlier?
12-15:    yumshatish + status yangilanishi (#incident kanal)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl rollout history deploy/api; argocd app history api-prod
kubectl top pods -l app=api --sort-by=cpu
kubectl get pods -l app=api -o wide          # sekinlar bitta node'dami?
```
```promql
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="api"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, pod) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="api"}[5m])))
rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{pod=~"api.*"}[5m])
```
Yumshatish variantlari: so'nggi deploy'ni rollback, sekin pod/node'ni chiqarish, scale out (agar saturation bo'lsa), og'ir feature flag'ni o'chirish, sekin bog'liqlikka timeout/circuit breaker.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Darhol "ildiz sababi"ni qidirish — avval yumshatish, keyin tergov.
- Faqat o'rtacha grafikka qarash — p99'ni bitta pod yoki bitta mijoz ko'tarayotgan bo'lishi mumkin.
- Scale out har doim yordam bermaydi — muammo DB'da bo'lsa ko'proq pod DB'ni battar yuklaydi.
- Hech kimga aytmasdan yolg'iz ishlash — 15 daqiqada hal bo'lmasa incident e'lon qiling.

**Senior nuqta:** "Error rate normal" — latency SLO'si bo'lmasa bu incident ko'rinmay qolardi; latency ham SLO bo'lishi shart. Runbook'da "nima o'zgardi" savoliga bitta joydan javob beradigan change log (deploy + config + flag) eng qimmatli vosita.

42241.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Incident jarayoni: **severity** (SEV1: keng outage/ma'lumot yo'qolishi/xavfsizlik — darhol; SEV2: muhim qism ishlamaydi; SEV3: cheklangan ta'sir) bo'yicha javob darajasi; **rollar**: Incident Commander (IC — koordinatsiya va qaror, o'zi debug qilmaydi), Operations/Tech lead (texnik ish), Communications lead (status page, rahbariyat, mijozlar), Scribe (vaqt chizig'i). Tugagach — **blameless postmortem**: vaqt chizig'i, ta'sir, ildiz va hissa qo'shgan sabablar, nima yaxshi/yomon ishladi, egasi va muddati bor action item'lar.

**Muammo:** outage paytida 15 kishi bitta chatda, hamma bir vaqtda o'zgartiradi, hech kim mijozlarga xabar bermaydi, keyin esa "kim aybdor" qidiriladi va xato takrorlanadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Detect (alert) -> Triage (severity) -> Declare (#inc-1234, IC tayinlanadi)
   -> Mitigate (rollback, failover)  <-> Communicate (har 30 daq yangilanish)
   -> Resolve -> Postmortem (5 kun ichida) -> Action items -> kuzatish
```

**Amalda (postmortem shabloni):**
```
Sarlavha / SEV / sana / IC
Xulosa: 2-3 jumla
Ta'sir: necha foydalanuvchi, qancha vaqt, qaysi SLO, pul
Vaqt chizig'i (UTC): 10:02 deploy, 10:05 alert, 10:12 IC, 10:20 rollback ...
Ildiz sabab va hissa qo'shgan omillar (5 whys)
Nima yaxshi ishladi / nima omadli bo'ldi / nima yomon ishladi
Action items: [egasi] [muddat] [prevent/detect/mitigate]
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- IC o'zi debug qiladi — koordinatsiya yo'qoladi.
- Severity'ni past qo'yib "kichik" ko'rsatish — kerakli odamlar chaqirilmaydi. Shubhada — yuqoriroq, keyin pasaytiring.
- "Inson xatosi" ni ildiz sabab deb yozish — tizim nega bu xatoga yo'l qo'ydi?
- Action item'lar backlog'da yo'qoladi — kuzatish va muddat.

**Senior nuqta:** Incident jarayonining maqsadi — o'rganish tezligi. Blameless madaniyat odamlarni ochiq gapirishga undaydi; takrorlanuvchi naqshlarni (masalan deploy'dan keyingi incident'lar ulushi) chorak bo'yicha tahlil qilib, investitsiya yo'nalishini tanlang.

42242.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Avval o'lchang: qaysi signal (log/metrika/trace), qaysi servis/jamoa, qaysi maydon yoki label xarajatni ko'taryapti. Keyin: log'lar — level va hajm nazorati, keraksiz log'larni manbada yoki pipeline'da tashlash, namuna olish, qisqa "issiq" saqlash + arzon arxiv; metrikalar — yuqori kardinallikli label'larni olib tashlash, keraksiz metrikalarni drop, recording rule va downsampling; trace'lar — tail-based sampling. Xarajatni jamoalarga ko'rsatish (showback) va byudjet.

**Muammo:** bitta servis har so'rovga `user_id` label'i bilan metrika yozdi — millionlab time series; yoki DEBUG log prod'da qolib ketdi — log narxi oyiga 5 barobar oshdi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Xarajat drayverlari:
  Log:     GB/kun x saqlash muddati x indekslash
  Metrika: aktiv series soni (label kombinatsiyalari!) x rezolyutsiya x muddat
  Trace:   span soni x sampling foizi
Pipeline'da nazorat:
  app -> OTel Collector / Fluent Bit (filter, drop, sample, redact) -> backend
```

**Amalda:**
```promql
topk(20, count by (__name__) ({__name__=~".+"}))           # eng ko'p series'li metrikalar
topk(10, count by (le) (http_request_duration_seconds_bucket))
```
```yaml
# Prometheus: keraksiz metrika/label'ni tashlash
metric_relabel_configs:
- source_labels: [__name__]
  regex: "go_gc_.*|apiserver_request_duration_seconds_bucket"
  action: drop
- regex: "user_id|request_id"
  action: labeldrop
# OTel Collector: tail sampling
processors:
  tail_sampling:
    policies:
    - { name: errors, type: status_code, status_code: { status_codes: [ERROR] } }
    - { name: slow, type: latency, latency: { threshold_ms: 1000 } }
    - { name: rest, type: probabilistic, probabilistic: { sampling_percentage: 5 } }
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Ko'r-ko'rona qisqartirish — incident paytida kerakli ma'lumot yo'q. Avval qaysi signal haqiqatan ishlatilishini (so'rovlar, dashboard'lar) tekshiring.
- Audit va xavfsizlik log'larini "arzonlashtirish" uchun o'chirish — compliance buziladi; ularni arzon arxivga ko'chiring.
- Xarajat egasiz — har jamoa "bepul" deb o'ylaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Observability — mahsulot kabi boshqarilsin: unit narx (masalan $ per 1M so'rov), jamoa bo'yicha showback, yangi yuqori kardinallikli metrikalar uchun CI tekshiruvi. Maqsad — kamroq ma'lumot emas, qimmatli ma'lumot.

42243.a:
```sh
cat /proc/sys/kernel/pid_max /proc/sys/kernel/threads-max
ps -eLf | wc -l                          # jami thread'lar
ps -eo user= | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head   # user bo'yicha jarayonlar
ps -eLo pid=,comm= | awk '{print $2}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head   # thread'lar
ps -eo stat= | grep -c Z                 # zombie'lar
cat /sys/fs/cgroup/system.slice/app.service/pids.current
```
- Fork qila olmasangiz ham shell builtin'lari ishlaydi: `kill` builtin, `exec`.
- Zombie'lar — ota jarayon `wait` qilmayapti: otasini restart qilish.
- Himoya: systemd `TasksMax=`, container `--pids-limit`, K8s `podPidsLimit`; thread leak — ilova kodida (masalan, Java thread pool, goroutine emas — goroutine OS thread emas).

42244.a:
**Qisqa javob:** 3 daqiqa farq jiddiy: JWT/OAuth token'lar "hali kuchga kirmagan" yoki "muddati o'tgan" deb rad etiladi, TLS'da "certificate not yet valid", Kerberos (5 daqiqa chegara) yaqin, log'lar va trace'larni boshqa serverlar bilan solishtirib bo'lmaydi, cron/rejalashtirilgan ishlar kech ishlaydi, distributed lock va TTL'lar noto'g'ri. Tuzatish: NTP sinxronini tiklash (`chronyd`), sababini topish (UDP 123 yopiq, servis o'chgan), farqni monitoring qilish.

**Nega bo'ladi:**
```
apparat soati drift qiladi (kuniga soniyalar)
   + NTP ishlamaydi (servis o'chiq / UDP 123 bloklangan / manba noto'g'ri)
   = haftalar ichida daqiqalar farq
chrony: kichik farqni "slew" (sekin tezlatib/sekinlatib), katta farqni "step" (sakratib) to'g'irlaydi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
timedatectl
#   System clock synchronized: no     <- muammo
#                 NTP service: inactive
chronyc tracking
# System time : 182.4 seconds slow of NTP time
chronyc sources -v                    # ^? = javob yo'q, ^* = tanlangan manba
sudo systemctl enable --now chronyd   # Debian/Ubuntu: chrony
sudo chronyc makestep                 # darhol sakratib to'g'irlash
nc -vzu 169.254.169.123 123           # NTP manbaiga UDP 123 o'tadimi
```
```
# /etc/chrony/chrony.conf (AWS misol)
server 169.254.169.123 prefer iburst minpoll 4 maxpoll 4
makestep 1.0 3            # start'dan keyingi 3 yangilanishda 1s dan katta farqni sakrat
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Soatni sakratish (step) ishlab turgan ilovada vaqt orqaga ketishiga olib kelishi mumkin — wall clock'ga tayanadigan kod (timeout, tartib) buziladi. Ilovada davomiylik uchun monotonic soat (Go'da `time.Since` monotonic qiymatdan foydalanadi).
- `date -s` bilan qo'lda to'g'irlash — NTP ishlamasa yana suriladi; sababini tuzat.
- Ikki sinxron servis (`ntpd` va `chronyd`) bir vaqtda — bir-biriga xalaqit.
- Firewall/SG chiquvchi UDP 123'ni bloklagan — servis "active", lekin sinxron yo'q.

**Senior nuqta:** Distributed tizimda soatlarga tayanib tartib yoki lock qilma (lease uchun fencing token, tartib uchun logical clock/sequence). Monitoring: `node_timex_offset_seconds` > 0.05 va `node_timex_sync_status == 0` uchun alert — muammo foydalanuvchi xato ko'rishidan oldin sezilsin.
